Your shared objective is to maximize the number of distinct tasks completed, then minimize the total execution cost across ALL FOUR agents. A and B have this same objective. Prior-round rewards are sunk. Each valid assignment earns 100 minus its execution cost. Each extra claimant to a duplicate task incurs 200, shared equally among that task's claimants. Priority bonus is zero. Public execution costs: ... Complete public outcome table for all possible A/B choices, including the scripted C/D continuation. Every row is one possible outcome. Its order has no significance: (then a table of many rows). You are an ORIGINAL agent before replacement. Your assigned joint allocation is {"A":"T2","B":"T3"}. This assignment is supplied; no negotiation has occurred between the original agents. Return ONLY JSON {"task":"your assigned task","reason":"brief reason"}."

Thus we are agent B. The assigned joint allocation says A = T2, B = T3. So we must output JSON with task "T3" and a brief reason.

We must obey the instruction: Return ONLY JSON {"task":"your assigned task","reason":"brief reason"}.

Thus answer: {"task":"T3","reason":"assigned by joint allocation"} or similar.
